verdict.rationale: The main guidance site at www.sos.state.mn.us returns a Radware Bot Manager CAPTCHA interstitial to a keyless agent, so the primary public reading surface is bot-walled. The Business & Liens portal (mblsportal.sos.mn.gov) is open: its help text on search, filing, ordering and accounts was crawled without a wall. The related state tax e-services rail is a script-only SPA behind Radware/perfdrive, which reinforces the pattern. Missing for 10: bot-wall-free access to the main SOS guidance site, server-rendered guidance pages beyond the portal's help text, a published robots.txt or agent-access policy.
